content:
Apple TV is set to launch a brand-new original comedy series "Brothers" next month, starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson. Check out the trailer below.

"Brothers" will premiere on September 23. The series is created by Lee Eisenberg, who previously worked on "The Office".

Apple TV is currently airing the fourth season of "Ted Lasso", but another highly anticipated comedy is also on its way.

"Brothers", starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, is a brand-new original series on Apple TV, with the two playing fictionalised versions of themselves.

"Brothers" will premiere on September 23 (Wednesday), with the first two episodes dropping simultaneously, followed by weekly releases until November 4.

The series is conceived by Lee Eisenberg, who served as a writer and producer on the acclaimed series "The Office" from seasons 2 through 6, and is a key member of the creative team.

Here's a synopsis of "Brothers" provided by Apple, followed by the trailer:

Besides "Brothers", other new content on Apple TV in September includes a new season of "Slow Horses", the original crime thriller "Last Seen", and the film "Mayday" starring Ryan Reynolds.

What do you think of the "Brothers" trailer? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, with discounts also available through an Apple One subscription.
